q: Biology is regarded as the study of living things, such as plants, animals and microorganisms.
e: True. Biology is regarded as the study of living things, such as plants, animals and microorganisms. Microorganisms are microscopic living things such as bacteria, protozoa, and many fungi. Biology systematically studies plants, animals, and microorganisms.

q: The whole world is now suffering under the impact of infectious disease outbreak and weather changes caused by the effect of global warming.
e: True. The whole world is now suffering under the impact of infectious disease outbreak and weather changes caused by the effect of global warming. Global warming is the rise in earth's temperature from extra greenhouse gases.

q: Morphology is the study of cell structure and function.
e: False. Morphology does not study cell structure and function. Cytology studies the cell; morphology studies form and structure.

q: Cytology is the study of cell structure and function.
e: True. Cytology is the study of cell structure and function.

q: Applied biology includes biotechnology, medicine, veterinary science, agriculture and animal husbandry.
e: True. Applied biology includes biotechnology, medicine, veterinary science, agriculture and animal husbandry. Animal husbandry is breeding and raising livestock, not growing crops. Biotechnology uses living systems in industry, medicine, and agriculture.

q: Biophysics applies the laws of physics to study the biological processes, like flight of the bird or echolocation in bats.
e: True. Biophysics applies the laws of physics to study the biological processes, like flight of the bird or echolocation in bats. Bats use echolocation; biophysics studies that with the laws of physics. Biophysics applies physics to living processes, such as bird flight or bat echolocation.

q: Biochemistry is the study of chemical substances and the chemical processes which occur in the cells and organisms.
e: True. Biochemistry is the study of chemical substances and the chemical processes which occur in the cells and organisms. Biochemistry studies chemical substances and reactions inside cells.

q: Biogeography explains how plants and animals are distributed on earth through space and time.
e: True. Biogeography explains how plants and animals are distributed on earth through space and time. Biogeography tracks distribution of species through space and time.

q: Biometry is the combination of biology and physics.
e: False. Biometry is not biology plus physics. Biophysics applies physics; biometry applies statistics.

q: Medicine and veterinary science are concerned with the restoration and maintenance of health in human and in animals.
e: True. Medicine and veterinary science are concerned with the restoration and maintenance of health in human and in animals. Veterinary science restores and maintains animal health. Applied biology includes medicine, which restores and maintains human health.

q: Animal husbandry is the farming of crops and breeding of livestock for food.
e: False. Animal husbandry is not crop farming. Agriculture grows crops; husbandry raises livestock.

q: Pure science branches study the basic facts or principles, such as the study of structure and function of living things.
e: True. Pure science branches study the basic facts or principles, such as the study of structure and function of living things.

q: Biology has strong links with physics, chemistry, geology, geography, mathematics and computer science.
e: True. Biology has strong links with physics, chemistry, geology, geography, mathematics and computer science. Biology also links to computer science, as well as physics and chemistry. Biology systematically studies plants, animals, and microorganisms.
